# ❔ **Why would you download it** ?

You need to download it if you want :
 
-  Adventure
  
-  Dungeon Exploration
 
-  Some treasures
   
-  Fun !


# 📖 **What's this mod**?
 
This mods add 2 structures et 1 mob. And soon many more structures and mobs with your help!

- A Nether Graveyard
   
- The Island of trial
  
- The Water Skeletton
 
- And three artifacts 
  
- And more in the future!

# ✅ **Features**:

## The Island of trial:

![The Sky Trial](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45886e7c9042ecb2127e942f7da142dcdeec4f91.png)

![The first piece of The Trial Island](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85cd6aef26fac255e26238617d550b6b5581e0ae.png)

![The Chamber](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ac29f2e0c6eecab2c79b4b2c476977da3ffe9c7.png)

![The library](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6695e081233492b9f2f173ee5444aee552e2f8cc.png)

![Another Image of The library](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8b0aeabadfe8163af11b6dc54dcad5ebe1f58de.png)

![Another Image of The library 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a24b8c8cc94fb3ed1fa59f111efa0035b979ee96.png)

Be careful, there are several chests in this room. Check the images above to be sure.

## The Nether Graveyard:

![It's a Nether cemetery with Nether fences and basalt tombs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/524e8b58310099699e7515e6b0ae009881153ab4.png)

This Graveyard hides many chests you need to find them !

## The Water Skeleton:

![It's an aquatic skeleton with algae on it and pink coral.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c6859333f7c8427ff7e7f7b80ef6c3688316885.png)

This skeleton doesn't have any attack animations yet, be careful!

## The Heart Rock:

![The Heart Rock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9d12d4c16e5c65fd4d3e75ca2c6a8a75660fd21.png)

This artifact give Strenght

## The Shield Artifact :

![The shield artifact](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aaf84b47a9e0a4bce6e2742f0065d5fb7a6b27bb.png)

This artifact give Resistance

## The  Whispering Stone :

![ The Whispering Stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5a4acdc0c497964c4de5431d2f7e70607ec427f.png)

This artifact give Night Vision and Speed
